SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand,
       COUNT(*) AS award_record_count,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_id = ma.player_id) AS share_of_total
FROM manager_award ma
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
